% A bent path to a signal node with text width, centered `~~~~` and
% negative inner sep: the node's size must be known to place the path.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{shapes.symbols}
\begin{document}
\setbox0=\hbox{\begin{tikzpicture}
\node[draw] (1) at (0,0) {};
\node[draw,signal,signal to=east and west,inner sep=-4pt,text width=5mm,align=center,font=\ttfamily] (2) at (1,1) {~~~~};
\draw (1) to[bend right] (2);
\end{tikzpicture}}
\gdef\SatexReachedEnd{}
\end{document}
